_README: Hevy template facts the exercise-library builder reads (deploy/exercise_library_integrity.py, #5861 fix round 13). DATA ONLY. `created`: library key -> {template_id, title} for a custom Hevy template created after the owner ruling of 2026-11-14 (the driver adds one row per creation; nothing else changes, and the next rebuild makes the movement loggable). `canonical_mappings`: a movement with no template of its own that is logged under another member of its canonical family, with the reason. `released`: a Hevy template id a library movement no longer logs under (its history, if any, stays where it was logged). `hevy_titles`: for every expansion candidate that names a template id, the title that template carries in Hevy; `differs_because` is required when it is not the candidate's own title. Check the whole file against a copy of the live template index with `python3 deploy/build_exercise_library.py --inputs F --template-index INDEX`.

kettlebell_suitcase_carry.why: the same carry with a different implement: the Suitcase Carry template names no implement and already holds both dumbbell and kettlebell sessions, so no other exercise's history is mixed in

D20D7BBE.why: Hevy's Sumo Deadlift: a barbell lift's template, so kettlebell sessions logged there would share one history with a different exercise (owner ruling 2026-11-14). Never logged; the kettlebell deadlift waits for its own template.
